scope: Four arbitrary binary syndrome values with affine rank three, outside the completed affine-plane result. Boolean parity columns are represented by nonconstant bipartitions of four selector states; offsets/complements do not change entropy.
binary_mask_meaning: State 0 maps to 0; bits 0,1,2 give values at states 1,2,3. Mask 0 is a fixed factor.
eligibility: Each displayed syndrome set has four distinct values, affine rank 3, covers every graph vertex through its nonfixed factors, and fails all prior full-state visibility generators.
representation_plan: Use all 15 partitions of the four-state selector, joint-information refinement/meet relations, and the actual local decoder given the join of incident parity partitions. Initial model uses only Shannon and the full-state factor gate, not conditional Delta gates from an unreviewed theorem.
not_a_claim: These are problem inputs, not FD winning supports, probability laws, entropy counterexamples, new bounds or scientific adoption.
